Marta G: heads-up — planning to run users.email backfill during 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight. who's owning rollback if we see high write latencies? :warning:
Kevin L: I can take rollback, @Marta. I'll be on call 01:45-03:30. What's the smoke plan?
Marta G: thanks — smoke: run `SELECT 1 FROM users_emails WHERE migrated=true LIMIT 1;` and hit GET /v1/users/lookup for a few known ids. watch p50/p99 and error-rate in Console.
DevOps Bot: migration slot created: migration-slot-20260317-02 (owner: eng-platform). Use `/slot cancel migration-slot-20260317-02` to remove. :white_check_mark:
Ashley P: I'll run canary traffic: 5% for first 10m -> 25% if metrics look good. I also have a rollback toggle script: `./scripts/flip_dualwrite.sh rollback` — tested on stage.
Leo N: I'll take DB snapshot at 01:30 and verify S3 retention. will post S3 object key here once done.
Marta G: summary: @Kevin rollback owner, @Ashley canary/kill-switch, @Leo snapshot, +me smoke ops. I'll post final go/no-go at 01:50 UTC.
Kevin L: :thumbsup: noted. ping this thread when snapshot completes and before flip.
